test_title: PYST 7: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 31 July, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Change the following from active to passive:

They have announced the results on the official website.

options.text: The results were announced on the official website.
The results have been announced on the official website by them
The official website was announced with the results.
The results had been announced already.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**. 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 
**__Key Points__** 
 
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence. 
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "They have announced the results on the official website." 
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the results" at the beginning. 
 
• Change the active verb form "have announced&q
